title: 第三章 十八条金龙
content_zh:
落神宗,山门。

    江尘此刻显得极为平静,丝毫没有担忧的神情。他所站的那列前面,一名长老正在仔细的对每一个想要加入落神宗的人,进行星力等级的测试,同时检查其年龄是否符合标准。

    其实,真正测试一个人的星力等级,是需要引星力星阵的。不过,如此多的人,即便是落神宗这样的庞然大物,也是很难在短时间内,就全部测试出来。而星缘石则不同,只需要一滴测试者的精血,便能显现出测试者的星力等级。

    “云翳,十四岁,星力等级红色。符合标准,进入下一阶段测试。”

    “潘耀,十五岁,星力等级蓝色。符合标准,进入下一阶段测试。”

    “离魅儿,十一岁,星力等级紫色。符合标准,进入下一阶段测试。”

    ······

    江尘顺着声音望去,一名衣着十分华丽,长相娇媚的少女,正昂着头,脸上露出一丝得意的微笑。这就是刚刚测试出星力等级为紫色的离魅儿,也是一个勾魂的主。

    正当众人还沉浸在离魅儿紫色星力等级的时候,却传来另一个让众人惊讶的声音。

    “虎芸,十岁,星力等级紫带金。符合标准,进入下一阶段测试。”

    江尘放眼望去,一个全身穿着虎贲战甲,确实只有十岁模样的小女孩,正一脸茫然的站着。女孩长得很是标致,年纪虽小,却也十个标准的小美人。最让江尘惊奇的是,叫虎芸的小女孩,身上有着一股军人的气息。

    一旁的离魅儿,原本得意的神情,瞬间便是变了。她眼中闪烁着一丝怨毒,凶狠的看了看虎芸。不过当她看到虎芸战甲上的图案时,却是赶紧收回了眼神。

    而虎芸被众人盯着,小脸蛋憋得通红,看上去很是可爱。

    很快,那名长老便是已经到了洛馨的面前。只见洛馨则是不紧不慢,将自己的名字以及年龄都告诉了那名长老后,便引出自己的一滴精血,滴在了那块星缘石上。

    原本透明的星缘石,在融合了那滴精血的时候,忽然折射出一道耀眼的金光。待金光过后,那块星缘石上便是出现了一条金色的腾龙,正自由的翱翔于星缘石上。

    那名长老,眼前忽然一亮,心中只有狂喜,很是高兴的道:“洛馨,十岁,星力等级金色。符合标准,按照落神宗的规矩,可直接入我外门修习。”
content_en:
Luo Shenzong, Shanmen.

    Jiang Chen looked extremely calm at this moment, without any worry at all. In front of the column where he stood, an elder was carefully testing the star power level of everyone who wanted to join the Luoshen Sect, and also checking whether their age met the standards.

    In fact, to truly test a person's star power level, one needs to attract the star power array. However, with so many people, even for a behemoth like the Luo Shen Sect, it would be difficult to test them all in a short period of time. The star edge stone is different. It only requires a drop of the tester's blood essence to reveal the tester's star power level.

    "Yunyi, fourteen years old, star power level red. Meets the standards and enters the next stage of testing."

    "Pan Yao, fifteen years old, star power level blue. Meets the standards and enters the next stage of testing."

    "Li Mei'er, eleven years old, star power level purple. Meets the standards and enters the next stage of testing."

    ······

    Jiang Chen looked along the sound and saw a very gorgeously dressed and charming girl with her head held high and a proud smile on her face. This is Li Meier, who has just been tested and has a purple star power level. She is also a master of seduction.

    Just when everyone was still immersed in the level of Li Meier's purple star power, another voice came that surprised everyone.

    "Hu Yun, ten years old, star power level purple belt gold. Meets the standards and enters the next stage of testing."

    Jiang Chen looked around and saw a little girl who was only ten years old and was wearing a Tiger Armor, standing with a blank look on her face. The girl is very beautiful. Although she is young, she is still a standard little beauty. What surprised Jiang Chen the most was that the little girl named Hu Yun had a military aura about her.

    On the side, Li Mei'er's originally proud expression changed instantly. There was a trace of resentment in her eyes, and she looked at Hu Yun fiercely. But when she saw the pattern on Tiger Yun's armor, she quickly withdrew her eyes.

    But Hu Yun was stared at by everyone, her little face turned red and she looked very cute.

    Soon, the elder was in front of Luo Xin. Luo Xin was unhurried. After telling the elder her name and age, she drew out a drop of her blood essence and dripped it on the star edge stone.

    The originally transparent star edge stone suddenly reflected a dazzling golden light when it was fused with the drop of essence and blood. After the golden light passed, a golden dragon appeared on the star edge stone, flying freely on the star edge stone.

    The elder's eyes suddenly lit up, and there was only ecstasy in his heart. He said very happily: "Luo Xin, ten years old, star power level gold. If you meet the standards, according to the rules of the Luoshen Sect, you can directly enter our outer sect to practice."
